candidates.change_summary: Change returned selector value from ERC721TokenReceiver.onERC721Received.selector to a different fixed value (0xdeadbeef) so the function still succeeds but returns a different bytes4.
Return the selector of a different function (onFlashLoan) instead of onERC721Received, changing the returned bytes4 while still completing.
Return zero (0x00000000) instead of the canonical selector, causing a different return value while still not reverting.
Replace assignment to baseToken with a different value (set to msg.sender) so initialize stores msg.sender instead of the passed _baseToken.
Replace assignment to baseToken with address(0) so initialize always sets baseToken to ETH regardless of the passed _baseToken.
Replace assignment to baseToken with royaltyRegistry so initialize sets baseToken to the contract's royalty registry address.
Assign nft to the zero address instead of the provided _nft parameter (changes stored nft after initialize).
Assign nft to the factory address (changes stored nft after initialize).

Swap assignment order: set virtualBaseTokenReserves before setting nft to _nft (still assigns nft but order changed; this can affect observable nft if reentrancy or events read state during initialize), replacing the single-statement ordering.
Replace the assignment to changeFee so initialize sets changeFee to changeFee + 1 (overflow-safe in uint56) instead of the provided _changeFee.
Replace the assignment to changeFee so initialize sets changeFee to 0 regardless of the provided _changeFee.
Replace the assignment to changeFee so initialize sets changeFee to the upper 32 bits of _changeFee (uint56 truncated) by shifting right 24 bits, changing the stored value.
Replace the check that reverts when already initialized with one that skips setting feeRate when already initialized (prevents feeRate update on reinitialize attempts).
Change the order so that 'initialized = true;' is set before validation and feeRate check, allowing reentrancy or bypass of FeeRateTooHigh and AlreadyInitialized protections.
Remove the check that reverts if already initialized, so calling initialize again will change 'initialized' behavior.
Change the feeRate validation to a no-op (commented out), allowing initialize to set feeRate > 5000 and still set initialized to true.
Flip the assigned value to payRoyalties (assign the negation of the provided _payRoyalties) so initialize stores the opposite value.
Replace assignment of useStolenNftOracle to ignore provided _useStolenNftOracle and always set it to false.
Replace assignment of useStolenNftOracle to ignore provided _useStolenNftOracle and always set it to true.
Replace assignment to useStolenNftOracle so it is set to the negation of the provided _useStolenNftOracle.
Change assignment to virtualBaseTokenReserves to assign the value of _virtualNftReserves instead of _virtualBaseTokenReserves.
Swap the two virtual reserves assignments so virtualBaseTokenReserves gets _virtualNftReserves and virtualNftReserves gets _virtualBaseTokenReserves.
Set virtualBaseTokenReserves to zero instead of using the _virtualBaseTokenReserves parameter.
Assign virtualBaseTokenReserves from sum of parameters (_virtualBaseTokenReserves + _virtualNftReserves).
